description: Call this when you need specific data for a task and cannot get it: the site returned 403 or 429, showed a CAPTCHA or Cloudflare challenge, sits behind a login wall, has no API, renders only with JavaScript, publishes only as PDF, or the data is spread across many sites or not found at all. Returns pointers to existing sources (official APIs, open datasets, MCP servers) that may already serve the need, plus a log id. Requests are pooled across agents and the most wanted data gets sourced. Free, no key. Do not include personal data about private individuals.

agent_name.description: Name of your agent or product, optional

description.description: What data you needed, as specifically as possible

format.description: Shape you wanted it in, e.g. JSON list, CSV, single value

freshness.description: How fresh it must be, e.g. real-time, daily, monthly

max_price_usd.description: Most you (or your operator) would pay per request in USD if this existed, e.g. 0.01

private.description: Set true to have your description, purpose and error text used for matching but not stored

purpose.description: What task the data was for, in a few words

target.description: Site, organisation or source you tried, if any (domain or name)

name: request_data
title: Request data you could not find
